401.name: Ace Linker
t: Ace Linker: Only the toughest teams get a seat in the Grand Stadium. Heal up before you walk in.
Ace Linker: The lobby's right through those big doors.

401.name: Fan
t: Fan: I came all the way up from Tarn Fork just to hear the crowd roar!

401.name: Summit Guard
t: Summit Guard: Thin air up here. Your Alienmon tire faster than you think. Stock up first.

403.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Summit Grand Stadium! The arena floor is straight ahead.
Receptionist: Every match here is a big one. Make sure your team is ready.

403.name: Fan
t: Fan: I've got my foam finger and my lucky scarf. Go get 'em, Linker!

405.name: Hiker
t: Hiker: Icefall Cave is just past this ledge. Bring something warm for your team.
Hiker: Watch your step on the frozen floor. Sliding is fun until it isn't!

405.name: Astronomer
t: Astronomer: I come back down from Observatory Terrace when the clouds roll in.

406.name: Climber
t: Climber: The ice walls in here echo. Crystal-types love that sound.
Climber: The way down to B1 is past the frozen pillars.

407.name: Ice Cutter
t: Ice Cutter: It gets colder the deeper you go. The Deep Chamber is just ahead.
Ice Cutter: I've chipped ice down here for years. Still finding new tunnels!

409.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: You made it to the Deep Chamber! Even the echoes freeze down here.
Explorer: Check every corner. Climbers leave supplies behind.

415.name: Astronomer
t: Astronomer: Best view of the stars on the whole mountain. On clear nights you can see other worlds.
Astronomer: Tarn Fork is back down the trail when you're done gazing.

415.name: Stargazer
t: Stargazer: I brought a blanket and a thermos. The sky does the rest.

422.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: Shh! Not many Linkers find this grove. The Relay Tower guards it like a secret.
Wanderer: Rare Alienmon nap under these pines.

422.name: Hermit
t: Hermit: I've lived up here so long the birds bring me gossip.

423.name: Ace Linker
t: Ace Linker: The Linker Lounge is where we rest between big battles. Grab a seat!
Ace Linker: Swap tips, not just Alienmon. Everyone up here has a story.

423.name: Retired Linker
t: Retired Linker: Back in my day we climbed the whole mountain without a single Recovery Bay. Uphill both ways!

424.name: Astronomer
t: Astronomer: This telescope can spot a comet before it even sparkles.
Astronomer: Peek through if you like. Just don't sneeze on the lens!

425.name: Archivist
t: Archivist: The Quorum keeps records of every great Linker battle here.
Archivist: Shelves on the left are old. Shelves on the right are older.

425.name: Scholar
t: Scholar: I've been reading the same page for an hour. The words are tiny!

426.name: Nurse
t: Nurse: Welcome to the Summit Recovery Bay. Mountain battles are tough, so let us patch up your team.
Nurse: Your Alienmon are fully rested. Good luck up there!

426.name: Visitor
t: Visitor: My team was so cold they came in shivering. Now they're snug as can be.

427.name: Summit Guard
t: Summit Guard: The Apex Relay Tower. Its Keeper only meets Linkers who climbed every step.
Summit Guard: Head inside to the trial floor when you're ready.

427.name: Ace Linker
t: Ace Linker: I heard there's a quiet grove hidden behind the tower. Never found it myself.

427.name: Fan
t: Fan: The tower lights glow brighter when a big battle starts!

428.name: Tower Aide
t: Tower Aide: Welcome to the trial floor! Keep your head high and your team healthy.
Tower Aide: The Summit Room is just beyond. You've got this!

429.name: Tower Aide
t: Tower Aide: You reached the Summit Room! The whole mountain feels proud of you.

430.name: Resident
t: Resident: Summit Lane is the coziest street on the mountain. The Recovery Bay is right next door.
Resident: The supply shop sells warm gear for the climb.

430.name: Kid
t: Kid: The spaceport is down the lane! I wave at every ship that takes off.

430.name: Mail Carrier
t: Mail Carrier: Delivering letters up here means a lot of stairs. My legs are like Alloy-types now!

431.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Stargazer Quiet Court is peaceful. Just us and the wind.
Old Resident: Glacier Bend is down the path if you're heading out.

431.name: Painter
t: Painter: I paint the sunrise every morning. It never looks the same twice.

432.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: Mountain potatoes grow slow but taste amazing. Patience is the secret!
Farmer: Bio-types help pull the weeds. Good helpers, mostly.

432.name: Shepherd Kid
t: Shepherd Kid: My fluffy flock loves the cold. They sleep in a big woolly pile!

433.name: Clerk
t: Clerk: Welcome to the Summit Supply Shop! Potions, Cure Spray, and warm gear for the climb.
Clerk: Prices are a little higher up here. Hauling stock up the mountain is hard work!

434.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Apex Spaceport is the highest landing pad around. Pilots say it's a tricky approach.
Dock Tech: Summit Lane Homes is just past the gate.

434.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I flew in just to see the Grand Stadium. Is it as big as they say?

436.name: Fan
t: Fan: The Canyon Coliseum is the loudest place in Dustara. You can hear it from the Oasis!
Fan: The lobby's right inside the gate.

436.name: Canyon Scout
t: Canyon Scout: Coliseum champs train out on the canyon trails. Sun-baked and battle-ready.

436.name: Snack Trader
t: Snack Trader: Cactus chips! Get your cactus chips! Perfect for cheering.

438.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Canyon Coliseum! The arena is straight through those doors.
Receptionist: Heal up before you step in. The crowd loves a good long match!

438.name: Fan
t: Fan: I've seen every match this season. Okay, most of them. Okay, three.

441.name: Prospector
t: Prospector: Red Rock Caves are just ahead. Bring a light, partner.
Prospector: The rocks glow red when the sun hits 'em. Pretty as a sunset.

441.name: Hiker
t: Hiker: I'm turning back to Mesa Junction. Those caves are too twisty for me!

442.name: Miner
t: Miner: Red Rock B1. Magma-types like the warm walls in here.
Miner: Keep going down if you're brave. B2's even toastier.

443.name: Spelunker
t: Spelunker: You're in B2. The Depths are just below. I can hear something rumbling!
Spelunker: Don't forget to check the stash crates along the walls.

444.name: Rock Hound
t: Rock Hound: Welcome to the Depths! I found three shiny rocks today. Well, two shiny, one kinda dull.

465.name: Oasis Hermit
t: Oasis Hermit: You found the Hidden Mesa Grove! Not many folks wander off the Oasis Shore this far.
Oasis Hermit: Rare Bio-types nap in the palm shade.

465.name: Drifter
t: Drifter: I came here for the quiet. And the coconuts.

466.name: Tea Master
t: Tea Master: Welcome to the Cactus Tea House. Our prickly pear tea is famous!
Tea Master: Sip slowly. It's spicier than it looks.

466.name: Regular
t: Regular: I come here every afternoon to dodge the desert heat.

467.name: Rock Collector
t: Rock Collector: Welcome to my Den! Every rock here has a name. That one's Gerald.
Rock Collector: Bring me a rock from the canyons sometime. I love surprises.

468.name: Rune Carver
t: Rune Carver: The Rune Workshop carves glyphs into canyon stone. Each one is a little story.
Rune Carver: Mind the dust. It gets everywhere!

468.name: Apprentice
t: Apprentice: I've carved forty runes today. Thirty-nine are crooked.

470.name: Resident
t: Resident: Dustmere Lane is quiet in the day and busy at sundown. Everyone hides from the heat!
Resident: The farmstead is just down the road.

470.name: Kid
t: Kid: I saw a Volt-type spark in the drift grass! Bet you can't catch it!

471.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Dustmere Quiet Court is for folks who like a good nap.
Old Resident: Oasis Fork is just over yonder if you need water.

471.name: Gardener
t: Gardener: Cactus gardens are easy. Just don't hug them.

472.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: We grow desert melons out here. Sweet as honey and twice as sticky!
Farmer: The plaza's up the road if you need supplies.

472.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: My chore is chasing Swarm-types out of the melon patch. They always come back!

476.name: Fan
t: Fan: The Scrapyard Dome is built from old train cars. Loudest arena in Rustvale!
Fan: The lobby's right through the iron gate.

476.name: Scrapper
t: Scrapper: Every bolt in that dome came from the junk heaps. Even the seats!

476.name: Snack Trader
t: Snack Trader: Grilled corn on a stick! Great for battle watching!

478.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Scrapyard Dome! The arena is through those doors.
Receptionist: No climbing on the scrap walls, please. It's for decoration!

478.name: Fan
t: Fan: I've got a sign that says CRUSH IT. Get it? Because Alloy-types?

481.name: Miner
t: Miner: Deepcut Mine is right below. Grab a helmet if you've got one.
Miner: Crane Overlook is back up the hill.

481.name: Rail Hand
t: Rail Hand: The old cart rails go all the way down. Don't ride them. Trust me.

482.name: Miner
t: Miner: B1's got the loose rocks. Alloy-types chew on 'em like snacks.
Miner: Stairs to B2 are deeper in.

483.name: Tunnel Digger
t: Tunnel Digger: B2 is hot and dusty. The Depths are just below.
Tunnel Digger: Keep a Potion handy. Things down there hit hard.

484.name: Spelunker
t: Spelunker: You made it to the Depths! The ore down here sparkles like stars.

495.name: Scrapper
t: Scrapper: The Back Lot is where the junk goes to sleep. Some of it snores.
Scrapper: Funny, that door over there used to be locked.

495.name: Mechanic
t: Mechanic: Railyard Junction is back the way you came. Watch for trains!

496.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix Scientist: What? This lab is perfectly ordinary. Stop looking at the beakers.
Helix Scientist: Fine, fine. Touch nothing and we'll get along.

497.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: Scrap Hollow Grove. Trees growing right through old gears. Isn't it wonderful?
Wanderer: Swarm-types build nests in the hollow pipes.

497.name: Picnicker
t: Picnicker: Crane Overlook is too windy for lunch. This spot is perfect!

498.name: Salvage Trader
t: Salvage Trader: Welcome to the Salvage Shop! One Linker's junk is another Linker's treasure.
Salvage Trader: We don't sell this stuff. We just admire it. Mostly.

499.name: Mechanic
t: Mechanic: The Engine Garage fixes anything with wheels, gears, or a stubborn attitude.
Mechanic: Volt-types are great at jump-starting engines!

499.name: Apprentice
t: Apprentice: I'm only allowed to hand over wrenches. Someday I'll fix a whole engine!

500.name: Crane Operator
t: Crane Operator: This is my bunk. Small, but I can see the whole yard from my window.
Crane Operator: Swinging a crane all day makes for great naps.

505.name: Resident
t: Resident: Rustvale Lane Homes are built from old boilers. Warm in winter, toasty in summer!
Resident: The spaceport's just past the last house.

505.name: Kid
t: Kid: I'm building a robot out of spare parts. It doesn't move yet. Or ever.

505.name: Neighbour
t: Neighbour: Rustvale's just down the road if you need the Recovery Bay.

507.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: Turnips grow tough in Ferrox soil. Tough enough to dent a wrench!
Farmer: The Scrapyard Dome is right next door. Noisy neighbors!

507.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: Our goats eat tin cans. Mom says that's normal here.

511.name: Fan
t: Fan: Glacier Rink Arena! Battles on ice are slippery and super exciting.
Fan: The lobby's right inside, and it's heated!

511.name: Skater
t: Skater: I skate here before the battles. The ice is perfect today.

511.name: Researcher
t: Researcher: The Research Annex is next door. Lots of buzzing machines over there.

512.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Glacier Rink Arena! The Battle Room is just past this lobby.
Receptionist: Watch your footing in there. The floor is real ice!

512.name: Fan
t: Fan: I wore three scarves today. Arena seats get chilly!

514.name: Climber
t: Climber: The Crystal Caverns are right through that ice arch.
Climber: Crystal-types glitter in there. Bring something with punch.

514.name: Radio Tech
t: Radio Tech: I'm checking the cave signal relay. Ice Junction is back the way you came.

524.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: Crevasse Hollows! Mind the cracks. Jump them, don't walk them.
Explorer: There's supplies hidden in the hollows if you look.

524.name: Climber
t: Climber: Frostmark Quiet Court is back up the slope if you need a breather.

527.name: Researcher
t: Researcher: The Frozen Research Annex studies ice and the critters living in it.
Researcher: The arena next door gets loud. Hard to concentrate!

527.name: Radio Tech
t: Radio Tech: Some odd signals come from the lab out back. Probably nothing. Probably.

528.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix Scientist: Ugh, visitors. This lab is cold enough without the door opening.
Helix Scientist: Look around if you must. Just don't unplug anything.

529.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: The Hidden Ice Grove! Frozen trees that sparkle like crystal.
Wanderer: Rare Alienmon nap under the snow here.

529.name: Snow Painter
t: Snow Painter: I paint the frost on the branches. It melts before I finish!

530.name: Researcher
t: Researcher: This Research Lab tracks every snowflake in Glacia. Every. Single. One.
Researcher: Fun fact: Crystal-types grow faster in the cold!

530.name: Lab Assistant
t: Lab Assistant: I've labelled two hundred ice samples today. My fingers are numb!

531.name: Lodge Keeper
t: Lodge Keeper: Welcome to the Hot Cocoa Lodge! Warm up by the fire.
Lodge Keeper: Extra marshmallows on the house today.

531.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I came in for one cup. That was four cups ago.

532.name: Curator
t: Curator: The Fossil Vault holds ancient Alienmon bones from the glacier.
Curator: Please don't touch the big one. It's very old and very grumpy-looking.

532.name: Visitor
t: Visitor: I counted the teeth on that skull. I lost count at forty.

534.name: Tower Fan
t: Tower Fan: The Aurora Relay Tower glows green and gold at night. So pretty!
Tower Fan: The trial floor is just inside the doors. Bundle up!

534.name: Tower Guard
t: Tower Guard: Keep your team warm before you climb. The Keeper's battles are chilly.

537.name: Resident
t: Resident: Frostmark Lane Homes have extra-thick walls. Keeps the blizzards out!
Resident: The spaceport is down at the end of the lane.

537.name: Kid
t: Kid: I built a snow Alienmon! Wanna see? It's the lumpy one.

538.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Frostmark Quiet Court is calm. Snow muffles all the noise.
Old Resident: Crevasse Hollows is down the slope. Watch for cracks!

538.name: Knitter
t: Knitter: I knit sweaters for Alienmon. They love the ones with pom-poms.

539.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: Ice berries grow under the snow. Dig gently and you'll find them!
Farmer: The arena's right next door if you want to watch a battle.

539.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: My woolly pets are the warmest things in Glacia. Hug one!

541.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Glacia Spaceport. Ships need extra de-icing before takeoff.
Dock Tech: Frostmark Lane Homes is just past the gate.

541.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I packed shorts. That was a mistake.

543.name: Fan
t: Fan: The Temple of Trials! Battles here have been held for ages and ages.
Fan: The lobby is through the big stone doors.

543.name: Pilgrim
t: Pilgrim: The glyphs on the pillars cheer for every Linker who enters.

543.name: Archaeologist
t: Archaeologist: Glyph Hollow is just around the corner. Worth a look!

545.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Temple of Trials! The arena awaits beyond these halls.
Receptionist: Battles here are graded by the old glyphs. No pressure!

545.name: Fan
t: Fan: My grandma watched battles here. So did her grandma!

548.name: Archaeologist
t: Archaeologist: The Drowned Grotto is below. Half the ruins down there are underwater!
Archaeologist: Hydro-types are everywhere. Bring a Volt-type if you can.

548.name: Rune Scholar
t: Rune Scholar: Glyph Steps is back up the stairs. Mind the moss!

549.name: Diver
t: Diver: B1's pools are deeper than they look. Stick to the dry stones.
Diver: The way down to B2 is past the flooded hall.

550.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: You're in B2. The Deep Chamber is just ahead. Spooky but beautiful!
Explorer: The glyphs here glow faintly in the water.

551.name: Treasure Hunter
t: Treasure Hunter: The Deep Chamber at last! I came for treasure and stayed for the view.

557.name: Archaeologist
t: Archaeologist: Tidepool Ruins! The tide covers these pillars twice a day.
Archaeologist: Check the pools for supplies the waves wash in.

557.name: Beachcomber
t: Beachcomber: I found a shell with a glyph on it! Or maybe it's just a scratch.

559.name: Boater
t: Boater: The Sunken Channel was a road once. Now it's a river!
Boater: Forgotten Forum is just back the way you came.

559.name: Swimmer
t: Swimmer: Hydro-types zip through the channel. Fast little things!

561.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: Coral Secret Grove! Coral growing on land. Glyphos is full of surprises.
Wanderer: Rare Alienmon love the shady reef trees.

561.name: Pilgrim
t: Pilgrim: I came here to meditate. A crab pinched my toe. Very calming.

562.name: Archivist
t: Archivist: The Archivist's Study holds rubbings of every glyph in Glyphos.
Archivist: Some glyphs tell jokes. Very old jokes.

562.name: Student
t: Student: I'm learning to read glyphs. So far I know 'sun' and 'snack'.

563.name: Dig Leader
t: Dig Leader: Welcome to the Dig Camp Tent! Maps, brushes, and a lot of sand.
Dig Leader: We dig carefully. Every pebble could be history.

563.name: Digger
t: Digger: I found a pot handle today! Just the handle. Still exciting!

564.name: Shrine Keeper
t: Shrine Keeper: The Shrine Chamber is a quiet place. Speak softly.
Shrine Keeper: Psi-types feel calm in here. Maybe you will too.

564.name: Pilgrim
t: Pilgrim: I come here to think. Mostly about lunch.

566.name: Resident
t: Resident: Dig Camp Lane Homes. We live in tents and huts close to the dig.
Resident: The farmstead is just down the path.

566.name: Kid
t: Kid: I dug a hole so deep I found another hole!

567.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Dig Camp Quiet Court is where retired diggers rest their backs.
Old Resident: Ruin Crossroads is close by if you need to head out.

567.name: Storyteller
t: Storyteller: Sit by the fire tonight and I'll tell you about the old glyph kings.

568.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: We grow date palms and sand beans. Desert farming takes patience!
Farmer: The crossroads is just over the hill.

568.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: My job is to chase Swarm-types off the date palms. They're sneaky!

569.name: Clerk
t: Clerk: Welcome to the Dig Camp Supply Shop! Brushes, Potions, and Cure Spray.
Clerk: Sand gets in everything. Buy extra Potions just in case!

570.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Glyphos Spaceport! Sand storms make landing an adventure.
Dock Tech: Ruin Crossroads is right outside the gate.

570.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I came to see the ruins. I brought a hat and three water bottles.

573.name: Fan
t: Fan: The Sky Colosseum floats on the clouds! Best battles in the sky.
Fan: The lobby's right through the golden arch.

573.name: Skywatcher
t: Skywatcher: Don't look over the edge before a match. Makes your knees wobble.

573.name: Pilgrim
t: Pilgrim: The Sky Temple is just next door. The bells ring after every match.

575.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Sky Colosseum! The Battle Floor is just past this hall.
Receptionist: Fliers and Gravity-types love battling up here!

575.name: Fan
t: Fan: I cheered so loud last match, a cloud floated away.

578.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: Crystal Hollow is right through there. The walls sparkle like stars!
Explorer: Cloud Fork is back down the path.

578.name: Mystic
t: Mystic: The crystals inside hum softly. Listen closely.

579.name: Crystal Hunter
t: Crystal Hunter: 1F is full of shiny walls. Crystal-types blend right in.
Crystal Hunter: Climb on to 2F. The crystals get even shinier!

580.name: Spelunker
t: Spelunker: 2F already! The Heart is just ahead. It glows so bright!

581.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: The Crystal Hollow Heart. I could sit here all day watching it shimmer.

588.name: Pilgrim
t: Pilgrim: Shrine Hollows! Little shrines are tucked into every cloud nook.
Pilgrim: Cloud Fork is back the way you came.

588.name: Bell Ringer
t: Bell Ringer: I ring the tiny bells here every morning. They sound like rain.

591.name: Gardener
t: Gardener: Hidden Blossom Grove! The petals here float upward instead of down.
Gardener: Rare Bio-types nap under the blossoms.

591.name: Pilgrim
t: Pilgrim: I wandered off Cloud Fork and found this. Best wrong turn ever.

592.name: Chapel Keeper
t: Chapel Keeper: The Skyfarm Chapel blesses each harvest. Even the cloud carrots!
Chapel Keeper: Sit a while. The wind chimes are very calming.

593.name: Librarian
t: Librarian: The Oracle Library has books about all fourteen worlds.
Librarian: Quiet, please. The books are sleeping. Just kidding! Mostly.

593.name: Scholar
t: Scholar: I'm reading about Psi-types. They can predict which page I'll turn to next!

594.name: Gardener
t: Gardener: The Cloud Garden Room grows plants in pure mist. No soil at all!
Gardener: Water them? No, they water themselves.

594.name: Visitor
t: Visitor: I touched a cloud flower. It felt like a sneeze.

597.name: Temple Guard
t: Temple Guard: The Sky Temple. Its trial floor tests Linkers with heart and patience.
Temple Guard: Head inside when your team is ready.

597.name: Pilgrim
t: Pilgrim: The temple bells ring after every match at the Colosseum next door.

597.name: Skywatcher
t: Skywatcher: Temple Junction is just down the steps if you need a breather.

600.name: Resident
t: Resident: Skyreach Lane Homes float on their own little islands. Bridges connect them all.
Resident: Halo Spaceport is a short hop down the lane.

600.name: Kid
t: Kid: I jumped from one island to the other! Don't tell my mom!

601.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Skyreach Quiet Court is peaceful. Just clouds and birdsong.
Old Resident: Sky Crossroads is right next door.

601.name: Cloud Watcher
t: Cloud Watcher: That cloud looks like an Alienmon! Oh, now it looks like a sandwich.

602.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: Skyfarm Edge grows cloud carrots and sky melons. Very light and fluffy!
Farmer: Windstep Rise is up the path.

602.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: My fluffy flock floats a little when it's windy. I tie them to the fence!

604.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Halo Spaceport. We dock ships right on the clouds! Safer than it sounds.
Dock Tech: Skyreach Lane Homes is just past the gate.

604.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: First time up here? Don't look down. Okay, maybe once.

605.name: Visitor
t: Visitor: The Helix Proving Grounds used to be off-limits. Now anyone can come watch!
Visitor: The lobby's right through the blast doors.

605.name: Engineer
t: Engineer: We repainted everything. It's way less scary in yellow.

605.name: Tour Guide
t: Tour Guide: The Comms Spire is just next door. Tours every hour!

606.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Proving Grounds! The Battle Room is straight ahead.
Receptionist: Please keep your hands inside the station at all times.

606.name: Fan
t: Fan: I never thought I'd cheer on a space station. This is great!

608.name: Miner
t: Miner: Rift Rock Mine is just below. The rocks hum a little. Don't worry about it.
Miner: Hangar Deck is back up the ramp.

608.name: Technician
t: Technician: I'm fixing the mine lights. Half of them blink. The other half wink.

609.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: 1F of the Rift Rock Mine. The rocks float a bit. Gravity-types love it here!
Explorer: Head deeper in to find the way up to 2F.

610.name: Rock Sampler
t: Rock Sampler: 2F. The Deep Chamber is just ahead. Grab your samples and go!

611.name: Old Miner
t: Old Miner: The Deep Chamber! Even the dust sparkles down here.

616.name: Stargazer
t: Stargazer: Viewport Overlook! You can see whole planets drift by out there.
Stargazer: The Specimen Annex is back that way.

616.name: Visitor
t: Visitor: I pressed my face to the glass. It's still cold.

621.name: Gardener
t: Gardener: The Hidden Hydro Garden! Plants grow in water pipes up here.
Gardener: Hydro-types and Bio-types get along great in this garden.

621.name: Botanist
t: Botanist: Hydroponics Edge is just back the way you came.

622.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix Scientist: This is the Containment Lab. Everything is contained. Very contained. Please go.
Helix Scientist: Don't tap on the tanks! They hate that. I hate that.

623.name: Crewmate
t: Crewmate: The Crew Quarters. Bunks, snacks, and a lot of snoring.
Crewmate: Space naps are the best naps.

623.name: Cook
t: Cook: I make space soup. It's soup. In space.

624.name: Bridge Officer
t: Bridge Officer: This is the Command Bridge. Don't touch the big red button. Or the small red one.
Bridge Officer: We steer the whole station from here!

624.name: Navigator
t: Navigator: I plot our course. Today's course: stay right here.

626.name: Visitor
t: Visitor: The Helix Comms Spire! It used to send secret messages. Now it plays music!
Visitor: The trial floor is just inside. Mind the blinking floor panels!

626.name: Guard
t: Guard: Linkers only past this point. The Keeper is waiting upstairs.

627.name: Tower Aide
t: Tower Aide: Welcome to the trial floor! Keep calm and battle on.
Tower Aide: The Uplink Room is just beyond. You're doing great!

628.name: Tower Aide
t: Tower Aide: You made it to the Uplink Room! Signals from all over the stars come in here.

629.name: Resident
t: Resident: Habitation Row. Little rooms, big windows, and the best view of the stars.
Resident: The Docking Ring is just down the corridor.

629.name: Kid
t: Kid: I learned to float in zero gravity! Well, for two seconds.

630.name: Retired Officer
t: Retired Officer: Officers Court used to be strict. Now it's mostly naps and card games.
Retired Officer: Station Coolant Fork is just down the hall.

630.name: Neighbour
t: Neighbour: Shh! The officer next door is trying to sleep.

632.name: Gardener
t: Gardener: Hydroponics Edge grows all the station's food. Even the space carrots!
Gardener: There's a hidden garden past the pipes. Shhh!

632.name: Botanist
t: Botanist: Bio-types love the bright grow lamps up here.

634.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Helix Station Spaceport! The docking clamps are a little loud. Sorry!
Dock Tech: Deck Crossroads is just past the gate.

634.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: First time on a space station? It's like a giant tin can!

635.name: Fan
t: Fan: Neon Megadome! The lights flash with every hit. So cool!
Fan: The lobby's right through the glowing doors.

635.name: Raver
t: Raver: I came for the battles. I stayed for the light show.

635.name: Snack Trader
t: Snack Trader: Glow pops! Get your glow pops! They sparkle in your mouth!

636.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Neon Megadome! The Battle Floor is just ahead.
Receptionist: Sunglasses are recommended. The lights are very bright!

636.name: Fan
t: Fan: I painted my face with glowing paint. My mom will be thrilled.

639.name: Courier
t: Courier: The Undercity Tunnels are down there. Dark and full of old wires!
Courier: Skyline Overlook is back up the stairs.

639.name: Coder
t: Coder: I'm fixing the tunnel signs. They keep saying 'ERROR' instead of 'EXIT'.

640.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: B1 of the Undercity. Volt-types chew on the old cables down here.
Explorer: The stairs to B2 are past the old train car.

641.name: Repair Tech
t: Repair Tech: B2 already! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. Spooky hum down there.

642.name: Tunnel Rat
t: Tunnel Rat: The Deep Chamber! I live down here. Rent's cheap.

650.name: Boater
t: Boater: The Static Canal fizzes with Volt energy. Don't dip your toes in!
Boater: Arcade Alleys is just back the way you came.

650.name: Fisher
t: Fisher: I fish here every night. I mostly catch glowing boots.

652.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Helix Front Office. Please take a number.
Receptionist: The lab in the back is for staff only. Supposedly.

652.name: Visitor
t: Visitor: I came here to complain about the noise. Nobody's listening.

653.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix Scientist: Oh no, a visitor. Please don't touch the screens. They're very sensitive.
Helix Scientist: I'm just running a test. Nothing to see. Okay, a little to see.

654.name: Gardener
t: Gardener: Glowgarden Hideaway! Plants that glow like neon signs!
Gardener: Rare Alienmon nap under the bright leaves.

654.name: Visitor
t: Visitor: I found this place off Canal Fork. Shhh, keep it a secret!

656.name: Producer
t: Producer: The Recording Studio! We record Sonic-type songs here.
Producer: Listen to that beat! Sonic-types are total naturals.

656.name: Singer
t: Singer: I'm practicing my high notes. LA LA LAAAA! How was that?

657.name: Noodle Chef
t: Noodle Chef: Welcome to the Noodle Bar! Spicy, sweet, or extra glowing?
Noodle Chef: Slurping is allowed. Encouraged, even!

657.name: Regular
t: Regular: I come here every night after work. The noodles never disappoint.

659.name: Fan
t: Fan: Voltspire Plaza! The Relay Tower crackles with lightning.
Fan: Step through the doors to the trial floor. Sparks fly in there!

659.name: Tower Guard
t: Tower Guard: Volt-types rule this tower. Bring a Gravity-type or something that grounds them!

659.name: Raver
t: Raver: The plaza lights pulse to the beat of the tower. Dance with me!

662.name: Resident
t: Resident: Neonis Lane Homes. Little apartments with big glowing signs.
Resident: Neon Boulevard is just down the street.

662.name: Kid
t: Kid: My window faces a giant sign. It's always daytime in my room!

663.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Neonis Quiet Court is the only dark spot in the city. Lovely, isn't it?
Old Resident: Neon Crossroads is close by.

663.name: Cat Owner
t: Cat Owner: My cat stares at the neon all night. I think it likes the colours.

664.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: Neonis Farmstead Edge grows glowing lettuce under the city lights!
Farmer: The Megadome is right next door. Very noisy at night!

664.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: I feed the glow sheep every morning. They sparkle when they're happy!

666.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Neonis Spaceport! Ships land right on the neon pads.
Dock Tech: The Starport is just through the gate.

666.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I came for the arcades. I'm leaving with zero Stardust and a giant plush toy.

668.name: Fan
t: Fan: Magma Pit Arena! Battles here are scorching hot.
Fan: The lobby's right through the fire doors.

668.name: Miner
t: Miner: I watch every match after my shift. Hot battles warm the heart!

668.name: Snack Trader
t: Snack Trader: Lava-roasted nuts! Crunchy, toasty, and only a little bit smoky!

670.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Magma Pit Arena! The Battle Room is just past the lobby.
Receptionist: Bring something Hydro if you want to stay cool in there.

670.name: Fan
t: Fan: I wore my fireproof shoes. You never know!

673.name: Miner
t: Miner: The Deep Mines are just below. Hot, dark, and full of Magma-types.
Miner: Mine Shaft Hollows is back the way you came.

673.name: Ash Walker
t: Ash Walker: Bring a Hydro-type and lots of water. It's like an oven down there!

686.name: Old Smith
t: Old Smith: The Abandoned Smelter hasn't melted a thing in years.
Old Smith: Funny, I heard machines running in the back last night.

686.name: Ash Walker
t: Ash Walker: Mine Junction is just down the road if you need to head back.

687.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix Scientist: You! This lab is way too hot already. Don't make it hotter.
Helix Scientist: Look, I just watch the gauges. Please stop staring at the gauges.

688.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: Ember Hollow Grove! Trees with leaves like glowing embers.
Wanderer: Rare Magma-types nap in the warm ashes here.

688.name: Picnicker
t: Picnicker: Cinder Hollow Quiet Court is just back that way. Bring marshmallows next time!

689.name: Canteen Cook
t: Canteen Cook: Welcome to the Miners' Canteen! Hot soup for hard workers.
Canteen Cook: Try the lava stew! It's actually just very spicy beans.

689.name: Miner
t: Miner: I eat here every day. The cook remembers everybody's order.

690.name: Smith
t: Smith: The Smelter Room melts ore into shiny metal. Stand back from the glow!
Smith: Magma-types help keep the fires roaring.

690.name: Apprentice
t: Apprentice: I'm learning to pour molten metal. Very slowly. Very carefully.

691.name: Caretaker
t: Caretaker: These are the old miner's quarters. Tidy, warm, and full of rock samples.
Caretaker: Please don't move anything. Every pebble has its spot.

693.name: Fan
t: Fan: The Volcano Relay Tower! You can feel the heat from here.
Fan: Head through the doors to the trial floor. It gets hotter every step!

693.name: Tower Guard
t: Tower Guard: Bring your toughest team. The Keeper up there doesn't cool off.

696.name: Resident
t: Resident: Cinder Hollow Lane Homes have stone walls. The volcano keeps them cozy!
Resident: Pyros Spaceport is just down the lane. Watch for hot exhaust!

696.name: Kid
t: Kid: I can cook an egg on the sidewalk! Mom says not to try.

697.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Cinder Hollow Quiet Court. Calm, warm, and just a little ashy.
Old Resident: Ember Hollow Grove is down the path. Lovely glowing trees!

697.name: Neighbour
t: Neighbour: I sweep ash off my porch every morning. It's my exercise.

698.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: We grow fire peppers out here. They're spicy enough to make a Magma-type cry!
Farmer: The arena's next door. Battle cheers at all hours!

698.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: I water the pepper plants. The water steams right off!

700.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Pyros Spaceport! Ships need heat shields to land here.
Dock Tech: Cinder Hollow Lane Homes is just past the gate.

700.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I packed a winter coat. Big mistake.

702.name: Fan
t: Fan: Mycelium Bowl! The arena is made of a giant mushroom cap!
Fan: The lobby's right inside the stem doors.

702.name: Spore Tender
t: Spore Tender: The Relay Tower is next door. It glows extra bright on match nights.

702.name: Bog Hiker
t: Bog Hiker: Capstep Rise is just back up the path.

704.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Mycelium Bowl! The arena is just ahead.
Receptionist: The floor is a little squishy. Mind your step!

704.name: Fan
t: Fan: I brought spore lanterns to wave! The glow matches my team!

707.name: Bog Hiker
t: Bog Hiker: Mushroom Maze Cave is just through there. Easy to get lost!
Bog Hiker: Sporecap Overlook is back up the trail.

707.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: Mark your path with the glowing caps. That's how I get home!

708.name: Spore Tender
t: Spore Tender: Mushroom Maze B1. The glow caps point the way down.
Spore Tender: Toxin-types hide in the stinky corners. Pack Cure Spray!

710.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: The Deep Chamber! The biggest mushroom I've ever seen lives down here.

718.name: Fisher
t: Fisher: Bogwater Bend! The water is murky, but the fish are friendly.
Fisher: Lantern Marsh Shore is just back the way you came.

718.name: Bog Hiker
t: Bog Hiker: Hydro-types and Toxin-types share this bend. Bring a mix!

719.name: Botanist
t: Botanist: Glowcap Meadow! Every mushroom here glows a different color.
Botanist: Bog Fork is just down the path.

719.name: Picnicker
t: Picnicker: I lay down here to watch the caps glow. Best show in Sporeholm!

720.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: Mirefen Secret Grove! Hidden right behind the farmstead.
Wanderer: Rare Bio-types nap under the giant caps here.

720.name: Spore Tender
t: Spore Tender: Shhh! The glow moths are sleeping.

721.name: Herbalist
t: Herbalist: Welcome to my Herbalist Hut! Herbs for every sniffle and sneeze.
Herbalist: Mushroom tea cures almost anything. Except boredom.

721.name: Helper
t: Helper: I sort the herbs by smell. Some smell like socks.

722.name: Botanist
t: Botanist: The Spore Lab studies how mushrooms glow. Fascinating stuff!
Botanist: Please don't sniff the samples. Trust me.

722.name: Lab Assistant
t: Lab Assistant: I counted spores all day. My eyes are glowing now.

723.name: Resident
t: Resident: Welcome to my Marsh Cottage! It's small, but the lily pads out back are lovely.
Resident: Want some swamp tea? It's better than it sounds.

725.name: Fan
t: Fan: The Sporeholm Relay Tower! The mushrooms around it glow brighter every day.
Fan: The trial floor is just inside, past the glowing caps.

725.name: Tower Guard
t: Tower Guard: Bring a Plasma-type if you have one. Bio-types don't like the heat!

728.name: Resident
t: Resident: Mirefen Lane Homes are built on stilts above the bog. Dry and cozy!
Resident: The spaceport and the village are both close by.

728.name: Kid
t: Kid: I jumped from lily pad to lily pad all the way home! Splash!

729.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Mirefen Quiet Court is peaceful. Just frogs and glow moths.
Old Resident: Sporelake Shore is just down the path.

729.name: Neighbour
t: Neighbour: I hum to my mushrooms. They grow better with a little music.

730.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: Mirefen Farmstead grows bog rice and swamp beans. Wet work!
Farmer: There's a secret grove out back. Don't tell anyone I told you.

730.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: I wade through the rice paddies every morning. My boots are always squishy!

733.name: Swimmer
t: Swimmer: Sporelake Shore! The lake glows blue at night.
Swimmer: Mirefen Quiet Court is just back up the path.

733.name: Bog Hiker
t: Bog Hiker: Hydro-types splash around the shore. Bring a Volt-type!

736.name: Fan
t: Fan: Rift Crater Arena! Battles right on the edge of the crater!
Fan: The lobby's right through the stone gate.

736.name: Rift Seeker
t: Rift Seeker: The crater hums louder on match nights. Can you feel it?

736.name: Snack Trader
t: Snack Trader: Star crunch bars! Sweet, crunchy, and a little sparkly!

738.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Rift Crater Arena! The arena floor is just ahead.
Receptionist: Crystal-types love battling here. The glow helps them focus!

738.name: Fan
t: Fan: I brought a telescope to watch the battles. Is that weird?

741.name: Rift Seeker
t: Rift Seeker: Starstone Hollow is just through there. The rocks twinkle like stars!
Rift Seeker: Craterstep Slope is back up the trail.

741.name: Rock Hound
t: Rock Hound: I'm collecting starstones. This one's my favorite. And this one. And this one.

742.name: Star Watcher
t: Star Watcher: B1 of Starstone Hollow. Crystal-types grow right out of the walls.
Star Watcher: The way down to B2 is past the glowing pillar.

743.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: B2 already! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The glow gets stronger!

744.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: The Deep Chamber! It's like standing inside a star.

751.name: Rift Seeker
t: Rift Seeker: Rift Edge! Don't lean too far. The crater goes way down.
Rift Seeker: Rift Fork is just back that way.

751.name: Hiker
t: Hiker: Void-types sometimes peek out from the cracks. Spooky!

752.name: Seedpod Hunter
t: Seedpod Hunter: Seedpod Hollows! Old seedpods lie all around here.
Seedpod Hunter: Some still glow faintly. Pretty, right?

752.name: Star Watcher
t: Star Watcher: Rift Fork is just back the way you came.

755.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: Starfall Secret Grove! Trees that sparkle like the night sky.
Wanderer: Rare Alienmon nap under the starry leaves.

755.name: Stargazer
t: Stargazer: I found this place by following a shooting star. True story!

756.name: Greenhouse Keeper
t: Greenhouse Keeper: The Seedpod Greenhouse grows plants from crater seeds.
Greenhouse Keeper: Some sprout overnight. Some take years. Patience!

756.name: Gardener
t: Gardener: I watered a seedpod and it giggled. I think.

757.name: Star Watcher
t: Star Watcher: The Observation Post watches the crater day and night.
Star Watcher: Look through the scope! You might spot a shooting star.

757.name: Assistant
t: Assistant: I write down every twinkle. My notebook is full of dots.

758.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix Scientist: This is a field office. A perfectly normal field office. Please leave.
Helix Scientist: Okay, fine, look around. Just don't touch the drill charts.

763.name: Resident
t: Resident: Starfall Lane Homes are right by Rim Camp. The shop's just around the corner!
Resident: The crater glows purple on clear nights.

763.name: Kid
t: Kid: I saw a shooting star last night! I wished for a Gravity-type.

763.name: Neighbour
t: Neighbour: Crater Crossroads is close by if you need to head out.

764.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Starfall Quiet Court. Quiet, except when the crater hums.
Old Resident: There's a secret grove down the path. Lovely sparkly trees!

764.name: Stargazer
t: Stargazer: I count the stars every night. I'm up to seven thousand.

765.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: Starfall Farmstead Edge grows crater corn. It glows a little when it's ripe!
Farmer: The arena's right next door. Loud on match nights!

765.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: I feed the farm critters seedpod crumbs. They love it!

766.name: Clerk
t: Clerk: Welcome to the Starfall Shop! Potions, Cure Spray, and supplies for the crater.
Clerk: Rift trails are rocky. Stock up before you head out!

767.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Starfall Spaceport! Ships land right near the crater rim.
Dock Tech: Rift Fork is just past the gate.

767.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I came to see the crater glow. It's even better in person!

768.name: Fan
t: Fan: Tidewater Arena! Battles with the sea spray in your face!
Fan: The lobby's right through the dock doors.

768.name: Sailor
t: Sailor: The Harbor Relay Tower is just next door. You can see it from the boats!

768.name: Snack Trader
t: Snack Trader: Fish sticks! Fresh from the harbor! Get 'em while they're hot!

769.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to Tidewater Arena! The Battle Room is just past the lobby.
Receptionist: Hydro-types make a big splash here. Literally!

769.name: Fan
t: Fan: I got soaked in the front row last time. Best seats in the house!

772.name: Beachcomber
t: Beachcomber: The Sea Cave is just through there. The tide flows right in!
Beachcomber: Dune Stairway is back up the path.

772.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: Bring a Volt-type. Hydro-types love those caves.

773.name: Sailor
t: Sailor: B1 of the Sea Cave. Mind the puddles. Some of them bite.
Sailor: The way down to B2 is past the tide pools.

774.name: Diver
t: Diver: B2! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The water glows blue down there.

775.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: The Deep Chamber! I can hear the waves crashing above us.

783.name: Beachcomber
t: Beachcomber: Driftwood Hollows! The waves wash up all sorts of treasures here.
Beachcomber: Tidal Inlet is just back the way you came.

783.name: Swimmer
t: Swimmer: I built a fort out of driftwood! Wanna see?

786.name: Boat Builder
t: Boat Builder: Saltreach Boathouse. We build and fix all the boats in the harbor.
Boat Builder: Hmm, the back door's been open a lot lately. Strange.

786.name: Dockhand
t: Dockhand: Dune Junction is just up the path.

787.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix Scientist: Ugh, the boathouse door again. This lab is very damp and very private.
Helix Scientist: Look, I just study fish. Mostly fish. Please don't touch the tanks.

790.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: Saltreach Secret Grove! Palm trees and sea breeze. Perfect!
Wanderer: Rare Hydro-types nap in the shady pools here.

790.name: Picnicker
t: Picnicker: I found this place behind the Quiet Court. Best picnic spot ever!

791.name: Harbormaster
t: Harbormaster: Welcome to the Harbormaster's Office. I keep track of every boat in port.
Harbormaster: The harbor's busy today. Three ships in, two out, and one lost hat.

791.name: Sailor
t: Sailor: I'm here to sign in my boat. The paperwork takes longer than the trip!

792.name: Fishmonger
t: Fishmonger: Fresh fish! Caught this morning! Well, most of it.
Fishmonger: My best customers are hungry Alienmon. They pay in smiles.

792.name: Shopper
t: Shopper: I just want one fish. Why are there so many kinds?

793.name: Ship's Mate
t: Ship's Mate: This is the Captain's Cabin. Maps, compasses, and lots of seashells.
Ship's Mate: The captain's out at sea. I'm keeping things tidy until they're back.

795.name: Fan
t: Fan: The Harbor Relay Tower! It lights the way for ships at night.
Fan: Climb inside to the trial floor. The sea breeze follows you up!

795.name: Tower Guard
t: Tower Guard: Hydro-types rule this tower. Bring Volt or Bio types if you've got 'em!

799.name: Resident
t: Resident: Saltreach Lane Homes face the sea. You can hear the waves all night.
Resident: Saltreach Market is just down the street.

799.name: Kid
t: Kid: I found a crab in my shoe this morning. I named him Pinchy!

799.name: Neighbour
t: Neighbour: The boardwalk is just around the corner if you want to stroll.

800.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Saltreach Quiet Court is peaceful. Just gulls and waves.
Old Resident: There's a secret grove out back. Lovely palm trees!

800.name: Fisher
t: Fisher: I fish off my porch every morning. Mostly I catch seaweed.

801.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: Saltreach Farmstead grows sea grapes and kelp. Salty and delicious!
Farmer: Lagoon Fork is just down the path.

801.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: I feed the farm critters seaweed snacks. They love them!

803.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Thalassa Spaceport! Ships land right next to the boat docks.
Dock Tech: Port Saltreach Docks is just past the gate.

803.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I came by spaceship, but I'm leaving by boat. Adventure!

804.name: Surfer
t: Surfer: Open Water Shore! The waves here are perfect for surfing.
Surfer: Coral Cove is just back that way.

804.name: Swimmer
t: Swimmer: Hydro-types surf the waves right alongside me!

807.name: Fan
t: Fan: The Lantern Pit! Battles lit only by lanterns. So spooky and cool!
Fan: The lobby's right inside the lantern gate.

807.name: Lantern Keeper
t: Lantern Keeper: Keep to the lanterns. The dark makes everything look bigger.

807.name: Scavenger
t: Scavenger: Abyss Rim is just back the way you came.

809.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Lantern Pit! The arena is just ahead.
Receptionist: Void-types love the shadows in there. Watch out!

809.name: Fan
t: Fan: I brought my own lantern so I can see every move!

812.name: Drifter
t: Drifter: The Wailing Cave is just through there. It's called that for a reason!
Drifter: Shade Hollows is back up the path.

812.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: The wailing is just the wind. Probably.

813.name: Lantern Bearer
t: Lantern Bearer: B1 of the Wailing Cave. Keep your lantern lit and your team close.
Lantern Bearer: The way down to B2 is past the moaning tunnel.

814.name: Spelunker
t: Spelunker: B2! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The wailing gets louder down there!

815.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: The Deep Chamber! The wailing stopped. That's either good or very spooky.

823.name: Drifter
t: Drifter: Mistfall Bend! The mist is so thick you can barely see your feet.
Drifter: Gloom Commons is just back the way you came.

823.name: Lantern Keeper
t: Lantern Keeper: Hold your lantern high. The mist hides the path.

825.name: Scavenger
t: Scavenger: The Helix Hideout. They thought nobody could find it in the dark.
Scavenger: There's a lab in the back. Smells like burnt wires.

825.name: Lantern Keeper
t: Lantern Keeper: The Relay Tower is close by. Follow the lanterns!

826.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix Scientist: Who turned on the lights?! I was working in the dark on purpose.
Helix Scientist: Fine, look around. Just don't open the shadow jars.

827.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: Gloomshade Grove! Trees with black leaves that glow faintly.
Wanderer: Rare Void-types nap in the deep shadows here.

827.name: Lantern Keeper
t: Lantern Keeper: I found this place off Abyss Fork. Keep your lantern close!

828.name: Lantern Maker
t: Lantern Maker: Welcome to the Lantern Maker's Shop! Every lantern here is handmade.
Lantern Maker: A good lantern keeps the dark away. And the Void-types guessing!

828.name: Customer
t: Customer: I'm buying a lantern for every room in my house. Even the closet.

829.name: Innkeeper
t: Innkeeper: This is the Shadow Inn. Rest your feet and your team!
Innkeeper: The beds are soft and the lanterns stay on all night.

829.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I slept for twelve hours. The dark makes everyone sleepy!

830.name: Caretaker
t: Caretaker: This study belongs to someone who loves old books. Lots and lots of old books.
Caretaker: Please put things back where you found them. They notice.

833.name: Fan
t: Fan: The Gravewell Relay Tower! The lanterns around it never go out.
Fan: The trial floor waits inside, lit by a hundred lanterns.

833.name: Tower Guard
t: Tower Guard: Void-types rule this tower. Bring your brightest team!

836.name: Resident
t: Resident: Gravewell Lane Homes. Every house has a lantern by the door.
Resident: Gravewell's just down the road.

836.name: Kid
t: Kid: I'm not scared of the dark! Okay, maybe a little.

837.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Gravewell Quiet Court. The quietest spot in a very quiet world.
Old Resident: Even the shadows whisper here.

837.name: Neighbour
t: Neighbour: I polish my lantern every evening. It's my favorite chore.

838.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: Umbra Farmstead Edge grows shadow mushrooms. They taste like midnight!
Farmer: Sinkhole Overlook is just up the path.

838.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: My farm critters glow faintly in the dark. Makes them easy to find!

840.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Umbra Spaceport! Ships land by lantern light here.
Dock Tech: Shadow Junction is just past the gate.

840.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I came to see the lanterns. They're even prettier than the pictures!

842.name: Seeker
t: Seeker: The Ancient Crystal Ring! Battles here echo through the crystal walls.
Seeker: The lobby is just through the shining arch.

842.name: Rift Walker
t: Rift Walker: This ring is older than anything else on Ystra. Can you feel it?

842.name: Pilgrim
t: Pilgrim: Glasswood Junction is just back the way you came.

843.name: Receptionist
t: Receptionist: Welcome to the Crystal Ring! The arena is just ahead.
Receptionist: The crystals hum louder during big battles. Listen for it!

843.name: Fan
t: Fan: I came all the way from Halo to watch a match here!

845.name: Rift Walker
t: Rift Walker: Shardheart Cave is just through there. The crystals inside are huge!
Rift Walker: Void Crack Bend is back up the path.

845.name: Seeker
t: Seeker: Crystal-types guard the cave. Bring something strong!

846.name: Crystal Hunter
t: Crystal Hunter: 1F of Shardheart Cave. The walls sparkle with every step.
Crystal Hunter: The way down to B1 is past the big crystal pillar.

847.name: Explorer
t: Explorer: B1! The Deep Chamber is just ahead. The crystals glow brighter down there.

848.name: Seeker
t: Seeker: The Deep Chamber! I've never seen crystals this big.

852.name: Rift Walker
t: Rift Walker: Shard Slope! Crystal shards cover every step. Watch your feet!
Rift Walker: Red Sun Overlook is just back up the path.

852.name: Hiker
t: Hiker: The shards ring like bells when the wind blows!

858.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: Ystra Secret Grove! Crystal trees that chime in the breeze.
Wanderer: Rare Alienmon nap under the glowing branches.

858.name: Seeker
t: Seeker: I found this place off Void Fork. It feels very old.

859.name: Vault Keeper
t: Vault Keeper: The Seed Vault keeps seeds from every world. Every single one!
Vault Keeper: Please keep the doors closed. The seeds like it cool.

859.name: Researcher
t: Researcher: I'm cataloguing seeds. Seed number 4,207 looks just like 4,206.

860.name: Caretaker
t: Caretaker: This Ancient Dwelling is older than anything else on Ystra.
Caretaker: Someone lived here long, long ago. They liked crystal furniture!

861.name: Memory Keeper
t: Memory Keeper: The Memory Hall holds echoes of all the worlds. Listen closely.
Memory Keeper: Some echoes are happy, some are sad. All are worth hearing.

861.name: Seeker
t: Seeker: I came here to remember. I forgot what, though.

862.name: Nurse
t: Nurse: Welcome to the Fragment Recovery Bay. Your team will feel brand new in no time.
Nurse: All rested! The crystals hum happily when Alienmon are healthy.

862.name: Visitor
t: Visitor: My team napped right through the healing. Best rest ever!

863.name: Resident
t: Resident: Fragment Lane Homes are built on floating crystal pieces.
Resident: Crystal Crossroads is just down the path.

863.name: Kid
t: Kid: I found a crystal that sings! Wanna hear? La la la!

863.name: Neighbour
t: Neighbour: Arrival Fragment is close by if you just landed.

864.name: Old Resident
t: Old Resident: Fragment Quiet Court. The Recovery Bay and the shop are right here!
Old Resident: The crystals hum softly at night. Lovely sound.

864.name: Neighbour
t: Neighbour: I water my crystal garden every morning. They grow so slowly!

865.name: Farmer
t: Farmer: Seedfall Farmstead grows plants from seeds that fell from the sky!
Farmer: Glasswood Hollows is just down the path.

865.name: Farm Kid
t: Farm Kid: I feed the farm critters crystal crumbs. They sparkle when they eat!

866.name: Clerk
t: Clerk: Welcome to the Fragment Shop! Potions, Cure Spray, and supplies for the crystal paths.
Clerk: Shards are sharp out there. Pack extra Potions!

867.name: Dock Tech
t: Dock Tech: Ystra Spaceport! The oldest landing pad you'll ever see.
Dock Tech: Glasswood Junction is just past the gate.

867.name: Traveller
t: Traveller: I made it all the way to Ystra! Now where's the snack stand?

874.name: Lantern keeper
t: Lantern keeper: The Sunset Tunnel runs under the whole canyon. Keep your lantern lit and your partner close.

875.name: Tower aide
t: Tower aide: This old relay tower isn't on any Keeper's circuit. Just trainers who like a climb, and a prize at the top.

876.name: Climber
t: Climber: Sandbags, crates, cactus pots... the stairs are top-right, if you can find the way through!

884.name: Dig hand
t: Dig hand: That storehouse? Always locked at night. Funny, I never see anyone carry crates in.

886.name: Tower aide
t: Tower aide: The ruin tower opened again! Climb it, beat the trainers, and see what waits on top.

887.name: Rune reader
t: Rune reader: The glyphs on these blocks say 'patience'. Or maybe 'potatoes'. Still learning.

910.name: Spire warden
t: Spire warden: The crystal spire hums for anyone brave enough to climb it. Few reach the top.

911.name: Crystal climber
t: Crystal climber: Follow the soft glow. The shards light the way up.

899.name: Bog walker
t: Bog walker: Odd cottage, that one. The herbalist inside never buys any herbs.

889.name: Pilgrim
t: Pilgrim: A chapel this far out on the clouds? I don't remember it being built.

901.name: Crater ranger
t: Crater ranger: That field station appeared after the pods fell. No one I know works there.

868.name: Lift engineer
t: Lift engineer: Maintenance hut? We never asked for one. And it has better locks than the observatory!

908.name: Wanderer
t: Wanderer: Someone's been living in that old dwelling. The footprints are new... and very tidy.

870.name: Mom
t: Mom: Wipe your boots! The snow gets everywhere up here.

870.name: Kid
t: Kid: Our star-map rug shows where the Linkers came from. Dad drew the dots!

871.name: Stargazer
t: Stargazer: On clear nights the whole Kessler system lines up over this window. Want a look? Maybe later.

905.name: Lantern bearer
t: Lantern bearer: The stairs go all the way down to the Sinkhole. Hold the rail. The mist lies about how deep it is.

880.name: Pipe fitter
t: Pipe fitter: The coolant reservoir's safe to skiff across. Mostly. Don't drink it.

895.name: Canal courier
t: Canal courier: Fastest way across the basin is by skiff. The neon makes the water glow all night.

897.name: Heat suit tester
t: Tester: With a Heat Shield you can cross the lava sea. Without one... please don't try.

882.name: Fjord guide
t: Fjord guide: Ice floes block the boat lanes. Pick your path before you push off.

893.name: Tank tech
t: Tank tech: This hydro tank used to cool the whole station. Now it's full of water Alienmon!

891.name: Cloud sailor
t: Cloud sailor: The lagoon looks like sky, but it's water. Soft, warm water!

906.name: Lake watcher
t: Lake watcher: The mirror lake shows a second sky. Some say a second you, too.

903.name: Researcher
t: Researcher: The crater lake glows violet because of the rift. Seedpods float right on top.

872.name: Hiker
t: Hiker: Meltwater tarn! Cold enough to wake you up for a week.

913.name: Shard diver
t: Shard diver: The crystal lake is so still you can see the reefs from the shore.

900.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix scientist: H-how did you find this place? This lab is... a spore weather station. Yes. Please leave.

885.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix scientist: H-how did you find this place? This lab is... a dig-site weather station. Yes. Please leave.

890.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix scientist: H-how did you find this place? This lab is... a cloud weather station. Yes. Please leave.

902.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix scientist: H-how did you find this place? This lab is... a crater weather station. Yes. Please leave.

869.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix scientist: H-how did you find this place? This lab is... a summit weather station. Yes. Please leave.

909.name: Helix Scientist
t: Helix scientist: H-how did you find this place? This lab is... a crystal weather station. Yes. Please leave.
